source_text:
6.7
Λούσω καθ' ἑκάστην νύκτα τὴν κλίνην μου.
Προτρεπτικὸν πρὸς τὸ δακρύειν ἐν νυκτὶ προσευχομένου.
pass_a_gloss: I-will-wash according-to each night the bed of-me. Exhortative toward the to-weep in night of-one-praying.
pass_b_english: “I will wash my bed every night” (Psalm 6:7).
An exhortation toward weeping in the night of one who is praying.

choices.why: Comment names the lemma as hortatory, not a report that he already wept.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
